data.title: Advanced Vocabulary Scan
data.description: Verifying your command of the high-impact words required for Band 7.5+ scores.

sections.sentence: Which word best completes the formal sentence?
sections.explain: 'Substantial' means large in size or importance. A professional alternative to 'big'.

words.word: There has been a substantial increase in prices.
There has been a massive big increase in prices.
There has been an extensive high increase in prices.

sections.sentence: Choose the best academic term for 'reduce'.
sections.explain: 'Mitigate' means to make a problem or situation less severe or serious.

words.word: We must mitigate the risks of climate change.
We must middle the risks of climate change.
We must moderate down the risks of climate change.

sections.explain: If something is 'compulsory', you must do it by law or because of a rule.

words.word: English is a compulsory subject in this school.
English is a necessary must subject in this school.
English is an enforcing subject in this school.

sections.explain: 'Ubiquitous' describes something that is present or found everywhere.

words.word: Mobile phones are now ubiquitous in society.
Mobile phones are now universal-wide in society.
Mobile phones are now all-around in society.

sections.sentence: Choose the word for 'strong and successful'.
sections.explain: 'Robust' describes a system or organization that is strong and unlikely to fail.

words.word: The company reported a robust growth this year.
The company reported a rigid growth this year.
The company reported a heavy-duty growth this year.

sections.sentence: Identify the word for 'possible and practical'.
sections.explain: 'Feasible' means able to be made, done, or achieved with success.

words.word: Building a new airport is not financially feasible.
Building a new airport is not financially do-able.
Building a new airport is not financially possible-easy.

sections.sentence: Choose the word for 'likely to cause harm'.
sections.explain: 'Detrimental' is a formal synonym for 'harmful' or 'damaging'.

words.word: Smoking is detrimental to your health.
Smoking is damageable to your health.
Smoking is destructional to your health.

sections.sentence: Identify the word for 'strong desire to succeed'.
sections.explain: 'Ambitious' describes a person determined to be successful or powerful.

words.word: She is an ambitious student with big goals.
She is an achieving student with big goals.
She is an aimful student with big goals.

sections.explain: 'Volatile' describes a situation that can change suddenly or unexpectedly.

words.word: The stock market has been very volatile recently.
The stock market has been very moving-fast recently.
The stock market has been very unstable-hot recently.

sections.sentence: Identify the word for 'able to recover quickly'.
sections.explain: 'Resilient' describes a person or system able to recover from difficulties.

words.word: The local economy proved to be resilient.
The local economy proved to be bounce-back.
The local economy proved to be strong-again.
